import os
fd = os.open('/data/digits.txt', os.O_RDONLY)
parts = [bytearray(3), bytearray(4)]
n = os.readv(fd, parts)
print(n, parts[0].decode(), parts[1].decode(), os.read(fd, 1).decode())
os.close(fd)

import os
fd = os.open('/data/digits.txt', os.O_RDONLY)
tail = [bytearray(2), bytearray(5)]
n = os.preadv(fd, tail, 6)
print(n, b''.join(tail)[:n].decode(), os.read(fd, 1).decode())
os.close(fd)
